what: R5 of the OI-126 successor free reads: the loss-interpolation sweep along theta(t) = theta_nom + t*(theta_k - theta_nom) for six Gate-5 members, with the step-2 output response read on the same forward passes.
authorization: Joseph 2026-08-23, code building and diagnostic tests including Slurm; single jobs well inside the standing 12 h grant. PET remains diagnostic/method-development (2e210468). Nothing here reopens OI-126.
HEADLINE: Six members measured. Under the DECLARED bars four are OPPOSITE and none reaches CONFIRM. Under the declaration's own stated INTENT with the corrected scatter, ZERO members are distinguishable from the nominal. The declared bars were built from a val-loss scatter estimated at 8.0e-04 whose measured value is 1.320e-03, and BOTH bars are consequently displaced in the same direction -- toward 'distinguishable', away from 'flat'. That is the single largest caveat on this read.

(a) DECLARED.standing: the declaration's construction with a WRONG input. No defence as an instrument -- only the standing of having been declared first.

(b) OWN-NOISE per member.standing: a supplementary instrument authorized later; arguably the scientifically BETTER one, since the relevant noise for comparing L_k(theta_nom) against L_k(theta_k) is that member's own evaluation noise. Never the declared bar.

(c) INTENT-GLOBAL corrected.standing: the FAITHFUL correction of the declaration: 3x/30x the MEASURED scatter 1.320e-03. Nothing about it is a new choice.

THREE_FRAMINGS_WITH_THEIR_STANDINGS.DIRECTION_OF_THE_ERROR: declared CONFIRM 2.4e-3 < intent 3.96e-3 -> HARDER to confirm; declared OPPOSITE 2.4e-2 < intent 3.96e-2 -> EASIER to oppose. Both bars share ONE denominator, so a single error in it moves both, and moves them the same way relative to 'distinguishable'. Checked in isolation either bar looks defensible; only the pair reveals the systematic push.
THREE_FRAMINGS_WITH_THEIR_STANDINGS.EVERY_MEMBER_MOVES_TOWARD_FLAT: all six move toward the flat reading under the corrected bars and none moves the other way: 49 goes from missing CONFIRM by +116.6% to +31.3%; 00/29/26/45 go from clearing OPPOSITE by +10.4/+10.8/+29.8/+30.6% to missing it by 33.1/32.9/21.3/20.8%.
THREE_FRAMINGS_WITH_THEIR_STANDINGS.verdicts_stand_as_DECLARED: bars were NOT moved; all three columns are reported.

RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.WHAT_THIS_SECTION_IS: The reciprocal arm predeclared at 66485599 and run as job 57502495 (COMPLETED 00:21:34). It evaluates L_nom(theta_k) - L_nom(theta_nom): the NOMINAL's objective at each member's parameters. A = dL_nom / dL_k(forward).
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.CITABLE_FOR: the two sign-inverted members' measurement, which is bracket-independent; and the aggregate that only 2 of 6 members received a DECLARED verdict.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.NOT_CITABLE_FOR: any mechanism for the P5A anomaly. Per 66485599 the reciprocal can only QUALIFY verdicts the DECLARED bars produced, and under the corrected bars there are ZERO OPPOSITE verdicts, so no outcome here licenses a mechanism claim. Four mechanisms have already been refuted on this member set and no fifth is proposed.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.THIS_ARTIFACT_IS_UNSTAMPED_BY_CONSTRUCTI: THIS ARTIFACT IS UNSTAMPED BY CONSTRUCTION, AND A LATER ARTIFACT WITH THE SAME LABELS WILL MEAN SOMETHING DIFFERENT. r5_reciprocal.py and r5_sweep.py capture NO run provenance -- verified: no SLURM_JOB_ID, gethostname, or timestamp reference in either source, and the artifact's top-level keys are schema, module_audit_roots, loss_normalisation_pin, sys_path0_after_imports, loss_domain, thresholds, t_grid, members, added_members_flagged. So for THIS section and the replicate comparison run beside it, two artifacts cannot be distinguished by content, and byte-identity across two paths is ambiguous between a perfect deterministic replicate and a copy of one arm over the other -- reported AMBIGUOUS-BYTE-IDENTICAL, which is TERMINAL here, not pending. Once r5_sweep.py is stamped, two legitimate runs MUST differ in jobid and host, so byte-identity would then indicate a PROVENANCE-CAPTURE FAILURE rather than a determinism success. The pointer is placed HERE, in the earlier artifact, because this is the one that will look wrong to a later reader -- the changed artifact announces its own change, the unchanged one does not.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.AGGREGATE: 2 DECLARED, 2 BOUNDARY_SENSITIVE, 2 UNDECLARED, of 6. This is WEAKER than the literal tally (3 NOMINAL_IS_OUTLIER / 1 SYMMETRIC / 2 UNRESOLVED) and it is the one the declaration supports.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.THE_MAP_HOLE_IS_MINE: The declared branch 'NOMINAL_IS_OUTLIER: A <= 0.25' is UNBOUNDED BELOW and its arithmetic swallows every negative A. Two of the three literal NOMINAL_IS_OUTLIER verdicts are sign inversions -- a direction disagreement, not an asymmetric magnitude. The branch is NOT moved; the two are reported UNDECLARED with the literal result alongside. NINTH failure mode for the boundary catalogue: an unbounded branch capturing a case of qualitatively different meaning. It is the dichotomy-over-decomposition mode one level down -- there the PARTITION was not exhaustive, here a single BRANCH is not homogeneous.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.THE_BRACKET_WAS_ONE_OPERAND_OF_A_RATIO: A = dL_nom/dL_k. Only the NUMERATOR was bracketed. The denominator's row-set range is the LARGER term (up to 34.6% of dL_k) and it makes a SECOND member boundary-sensitive: replica_49 flips SYMMETRIC/UNRESOLVED under the denominator range while stable under the numerator pull, and replica_26 does the opposite. The claim 'only one of six is boundary-sensitive' was an artifact of bracketing one side. TENTH failure mode: a bracket covering one operand of a ratio, so the reported sensitivity is a LOWER BOUND on the real one. The catalogued unifier -- a bar is a ratio in disguise, name the implicit denominator -- fired here on a ratio that was never in disguise: the disguise was never the problem, checking ONE operand of a pair is.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.THE_SIGN_RESULT_IS_THE_ONLY_BAR_INDEPEND: replica_29 dL_nom = -4.490234e-03 = -3.40 x the nominal's own validation scatter (1.3200079e-03); replica_43 dL_nom = -3.571110e-03 = -2.71 x. Both stay negative under the numerator pull bracket, the joint pull bracket AND the denominator row-set range. So two of six members' parameters are BETTER on the nominal's own objective than the nominal's own parameters are. This is a measurement about the NOMINAL'S OPTIMALITY, explicitly not an explanation of the anomaly. UNDECLARED is a statement about the VERDICT MAP, not about this measurement.
RECIPROCAL_ARM_20260824.A_SMALL_DENOMINATOR_EFFECT_HERE_DOES_NOT: replica_49's dL_k = 5.198768e-03 is 4.6x smaller than the next smallest, which is why a 34.6% row-set deviation moves its A across 0.5. That is a small-denominator mechanism genuinely mattering -- and it is NOT the one I proposed for max_rel in the endpoint check, which was REFUTED by measuring |w_push| = 1.943e-01 at replica_43's max-rel row. Different statistic. The refutation stands.

REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.external_evidence_THE_COPY_BRANCH_IS_REF: The ambiguity's copy branch is refuted by evidence the verdict's own definition does not consider. Operands, all outside the artifact: (1) TWO DISTINCT PROCESSES -- r5_26.log and r5_26_worker.log are both 4044 B and cmp DIFFER, the difference being the timestamped TF/XLA startup lines, with first stamps 2026-08-23 14:47:54 and 2026-08-23 23:58:00; both end with 'wrote /pscratch/.../OI126_R5_SWEEP_26.json'. REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.surviving_reading: Cross-node numerical determinism of the PET full-event sweep: two independent ~29-minute executions, different nodes, about nine hours apart, byte-identical output. A reader must be able to see BOTH that the verdict is AMBIGUOUS by declaration AND that the ambiguity has in fact been resolved by evidence the declaration did not contemplate.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.WHAT_THIS_DETERMINISM_RESULT_IS_NOT: It says nothing about OI-126's gate. Reproducibility is a different object from coverage per Joseph's own ruling, and this licenses nothing about estimator-equivalence. It also does NOT rescue the noise-floor machinery: byte-identity short-circuits before any difference is computed, so the min()-across-arms floor and the noise-floor gate remain exercised on FIXTURES ONLY.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.own_epoch_scatter_IS_NOT_A_RUN_TO_RUN_NO: WHAT own_epoch_scatter IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT A FLOOR FOR. Raised by PET mentor, who withdrew a finding built on this and the withdrawal reaches into this receipt. own_epoch_scatter/val_successive_diff_sd measures SUCCESSIVE-EPOCH validation differences WITHIN one training run -- i.e. training dynamics. It is used in this receipt in exactly two places, both as a STATED UNIT for a loss difference (dL_nom in units of the nominal's own scatter; the divergence-window scale for replica_26). Those uses are disclosed normalisations and they stand. They are NOT significance statements: '-3.40 x the nominal's own validation scatter' must not be read as '3.4 sigma', because epoch-to-epoch wobble within one run is not the sampling distribution of the quantity being normalised. AND IT IS NOT A NOISE FLOOR FOR RUN-TO-RUN REPRODUCIBILITY. The replicate control's D is a difference BETWEEN two runs; epoch scatter is variation WITHIN one. Using the latter as a floor for the former is the WRONG-NOISE-STATISTIC mode (mode 3 of the boundary catalogue) and it produced a false prediction: the argument was that two good runs would differ by ~7.05e-04 so the REPRODUCIBLE bar (5.5e-04) was empty by construction. MEASURED: D = 0.000e+00, so the bar was trivially attainable. THE 'BAR BELOW ITS OWN NOISE FLOOR' CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN -- it was never committed to this receipt, and it is recorded here as withdrawn so it cannot re-enter from the conversation that produced it. What survives is small and uninteresting: the epoch scatter happens to exceed the bar, which is a true fact about two unrelated quantities.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.CONSEQUENCE_THE_FLOOR_MACHINERY_IS_INAPP: CONSEQUENCE: THE NOISE-FLOOR MACHINERY IS INAPPLICABLE, NOT MERELY UNEXERCISED. An earlier field in this section recorded the min()-across-arms floor and the floor gate as 'exercised on FIXTURES ONLY'. That understates it. Their floor is derived from within-run epoch variation, so their disclaimer would assert that a nonzero run-to-run D is 'consistent with the noise floor' on irrelevant grounds -- excusing a real difference, which is the same laundering hazard that was flagged in the label-gated version, arriving instead from the operand. The floor gate is therefore NOT to be applied to a future replicate comparison until the floor is re-derived from RUN-TO-RUN differences, of which there is now exactly one observation: zero. AND THE CONTROL'S DESIGN IS THE DEEPER ISSUE. The declared bars presuppose a continuum of differences. The pipeline is deterministic, so D takes essentially one value, and a threshold on a near-degenerate distribution is not a measurement. For a deterministic pipeline the informative question is not HOW BIG is D but IS IT EXACTLY ZERO, AND IF NOT WHAT CHANGED. That is why the floor machinery went unexercised -- structural, not a fluke of this run -- and it is why the path-identity / byte-identity primitive is the right one here: it asks the binary question.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.MY_ORIGINAL_PRECONDITION_WOULD_HAVE_REJE: Arm 3 was first written as `if primary_md5 == RESCUE_PINNED_MD5: fail`, on the assumption that bit-identity between two independent runs was rarer than a merge bug. On this data it would have emitted NOT-RUN with the reason 'the primary run did not write, or wrote the preserved arm's bytes' -- WRONG ON BOTH DISJUNCTS: the run did write at 00:27:20, and the identical bytes are the finding rather than the failure. A 29-minute run and the cleanest determinism evidence in the campaign would have been discarded as a broken precondition with a plausible reason attached. The defect passed a three-arm test because arm 2's fixture used two files with DIFFERENT contents, so the byte-identical case -- the guard's own strictest input -- was never exercised. A guard's does-not-fire arm is not a formality; here it was the arm that fired on the first real invocation.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.THE_PRESERVED_ARM_WAS_LOAD_BEARING: run_r5_26.sh writes the same path the earlier arm occupied. Without the byte-identical copy taken before this run, there would be ONE file at that path and the comparison would have been a self-comparison returning a difference of exactly zero, with no tell. The same file has now been the wrong operand in two opposite ways -- self-comparison when duplicated into the member set, and a destroyed operand when overwritten in place -- both from the PATH being reused rather than the RUNS being distinguished.
REPLICATE_CONTROL_20260824.WHAT_STAMPING_WILL_DO_TO_THIS_VERDICT: r5_sweep.py captures no run provenance (verified at the PRODUCER: zero references to SLURM|gethostname|getfqdn|uname|socket|datetime|time.time|strftime|getpid, AND zero to the wholesale routes os.environ|locals()|vars()|globals()|**kwargs, and no other script post-processes the artifact -- a producer-capability search is covering only once the wholesale routes are closed). Once stamped, two legitimate runs MUST differ in jobid and host, so byte-identity becomes IMPOSSIBLE for legitimate runs -- and the determinism result here makes that inversion sharper, not weaker: because the numerics are deterministic, any FUTURE byte-identical pair is unambiguously a PROVENANCE-CAPTURE FAILURE rather than a determinism success. The stamp and this branch's semantics must land in one commit.

AGGREGATE_GUARD.excluded_bands_note: computed over the whole integer count range, not its endpoints -- endpoint-only would wrongly exclude an attainable intermediate band
AGGREGATE_GUARD.SCOPE_FORBIDDING_SENTENCE: This count is a property of THESE SIX members, not a rate for the 50. The six were selected on BAND-RATIO statistics (two extremes, two medians, the shallowest-dip outlier, and one spanning an aggregation ambiguity) while divergence depends on each member's own NOISE (val successive-difference sd). Noise is therefore incidental to the selection rather than balanced by it, so the divergence rate here is plausibly but not demonstrably representative of the family. The guard answers whether THIS SWEEP's verdicts are boundary-dependent -- it is NOT an estimate of what fraction of the 50 would diverge, and must not be read as one.

INVERTED_BRANCH.declared: dL <= -2.4e-02: theta_nom distinguishably BETTER on k's own HELD-OUT objective
INVERTED_BRANCH.READING_IF_IT_FIRES: NOT a training failure. L_k is evaluated on a HELD-OUT slice while theta_k minimised the TRAINING objective, so theta_nom beating theta_k on k's held-out data is an ordinary generalisation result -- and theta_k trained on Poisson-thinned weights, which halve the effective sample size, so it had a noisier optimisation than theta_nom on unthinned weights. (a) It does NOT support the flat-direction mechanism: a large |dL| in either direction means the two points are distinguishable, the opposite of flat. (b) It is evidence about OVERFITTING rather than under-drifting -- a different mechanism from the one the sweep probes, and not a version of the drift-deficit claim. (c) It does NOT impugn that member's cross section or its C_stat contribution: generalisation on a held-out LOSS slice is a different object from the extracted cross section and nothing licenses transferring one to the other.

VERDICT_FRAGILITY.WHY_FRAGILE_AND_IT_BELONGS_IN_THE_VERDIC: Divergence depends on each member's OWN NOISE against a fixed bar, and the six members were selected on BAND-RATIO statistics, not on noise. This is the guard working as specified, NOT a defect in it, but a reader seeing BOUNDARY-DEPENDENT without this will take it as a property of the mechanism.

AGGREGATE_GUARD.LABEL_SCOPE: report as QUALIFIED(boundary-sensitivity), never bare QUALIFIED. The guard classifies BOUNDARY-SENSITIVITY, not mechanism evidence, and ROBUST/QUALIFIED/BOUNDARY-DEPENDENT all parse as claims about the world while all three are claims about criteria. OPPOSITE, INVERTED, CONFIRM, BARRIER and UNRESOLVED keep bare tokens because they are about the measurement -- the annotated set is a considered subset, not an oversight.
AGGREGATE_GUARD.NO_MECHANISM_CLAUSE: QUALIFIED(boundary-sensitivity) does NOT license a mechanism claim. Under the faithful framing (c) there are ZERO OPPOSITE verdicts, so there is no distinguishability result for a mechanism to explain.
AGGREGATE_GUARD.COUNT_AGREEMENT_IS_COINCIDENCE: a-vs-b {29,45} and c-vs-b {00,26} both have count 2 with an EMPTY intersection. The verdict is invariant under the correction; the evidence for it is entirely disjoint. At m=6 the count agreement is coincidence and is NOT convergence.
